items.t: Steering relay rod can crack and break (recall)
Head gasket failure on the 3.4L V6
items.note: Ask the dealer whether Toyota campaign X01 already covered your truck. Machine work on the heads adds cost.

items.t: Rusted front lower control arm can break
items.note: RepairPal lists $1,400–$1,545 for a control arm job; seized rusty bolts can add labor.

items.t: Seat belts won't retract or lock
items.job: Replace front seat belt retractor assembly
items.note: Price is per seat for a genuine Toyota belt assembly.

items.job: Replace drive shaft U-joints and balance wheels
items.note: U-joints cost about $5–$48 each at Advance Auto Parts. A complete drive shaft is far more: YourMechanic estimates about $2,475–$2,620.

items.t: Dealer-installed cruise control goes past set speed (recall)
items.note: Only trucks with the dealer-installed cruise units covered by the recall qualify.

items.t: Won't crank because of a worn starter
items.note: YourMechanic averages about $297; its T100-specific estimates start around $459.

items.t: Automatic transmission shifting poorly at high mileage
items.note: Kelley Blue Book lists $6,716–$7,214 at a dealer for a new transmission. A used or rebuilt unit, or a fluid service when the fluid is only old, can cost less.

items.t: Truck can roll with the shifter in Park
items.job: Diagnose shift linkage and Park position
items.note: Price is for the inspection only (YourMechanic: about $95–$115). A new shift cable or Park pawl repair costs extra.

items.t: Blower motor wiring overheats and melts
items.job: Replace blower motor resistor and connector
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $300–$305 for the resistor on 1996–1998 T100s. Repairing a melted harness adds labor.

items.t: Rear axle seal leaks oil onto the brakes
items.job: Replace rear axle seal and rear brake shoes
items.note: Includes new rear shoes; YourMechanic lists about $400–$500 for a rear shoe job alone.

items.t: Hard brake pedal from vacuum or booster failure
Check engine light from EGR valve faults
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $420–$430 for 1996–1998 T100s. A vacuum switching valve alone costs less.
YourMechanic estimates about $433–$441 for 1996–1998 T100s. A cable or drive gear is priced separately.
